衔接词与语篇连贯:第三年综合演练: 用 however、therefore、in contrast 等衔接词把长难句、虚拟、倒装、强调串成连贯语篇,并做全年综合自测。

转折:however, nevertheless, on the contrary, in contrast|因果:therefore, consequently, as a result, hence|递进/补充:moreover, furthermore, what is more|顺序与总结:first, then, finally, in short, to sum up|衔接词选错会颠倒逻辑:先判断两句关系再选词
The pilot was delayed; therefore, the whole schedule slipped.
column3: 飞行员迟到,因此整个日程都顺延了。

衔接词与语篇连贯:第三年综合演练: The data looked solid; however, the sample was tiny.
column3: 数据看起来扎实,然而样本极小。

衔接词与语篇连贯:第三年综合演练: Moreover, the trend has repeated in three markets.
column3: 此外,这一趋势已在三个市场重演。

衔接词与语篇连贯:第三年综合演练: In short, the campaign worked despite the budget.
column3: 总之,尽管预算有限,活动还是奏效了。

衔接词与语篇连贯:第三年综合演练: Had we known the risks, we would never have set sail; nevertheless, the voyage taught us plenty.
column3: 早知风险我们绝不会出海;不过这趟航行让我们学到很多。

# title: The hotel was fully booked; ___, we found a room nearby.
column4: 前后是转折关系(订满了却找到房),用 however。

# title: Sales doubled; ___, the board doubled the marketing budget.
column4: 因果:销量翻倍,于是预算翻倍,用 consequently。

# title: The instructions were clear. ___, the volunteers needed a briefing.
column4: 前后转折:清晰但志愿者仍需培训,用 Nevertheless。

# title: ___, let me thank the crew and recap tonight's plan.
衔接词与语篇连贯:第三年综合演练: In contrast|To begin with|To sum up|Even so
column4: 结尾总结场景,用 To sum up。

# title: ___ the delays, the festival broke even.
column4: 后接名词短语 the delays,用介词 Despite。

# title: Had the alarm worked, the warehouse ___ .
衔接词与语篇连贯:第三年综合演练: would not burn|would not have burned|did not burn|had not burned
column4: 综合演练:与过去相反的虚拟 + 结尾语篇,选 would not have burned。
